findings.evidence: Lines 43 and 61 bind `(C : Submodule F (ι → F))`; the adjacent integral identities are declared under `namespace Submodule` in `MacWilliams/Basic.lean:55`.
findings.fix: Place both declarations in the root `Submodule` namespace (without compatibility aliases).
findings.issue: `aeval_weightEnumerator_euclideanDual` and `aeval_weightEnumerator_normalized_of_eq_euclideanDual` take a `Submodule` as their first explicit argument but are in `TauCeti`, preventing the expected `C.…` API.

findings.evidence: Line 30 begins with `(hp : p.IsHomogeneous n)`; `Mathlib/RingTheory/MvPolynomial/Homogeneous.lean` has `namespace MvPolynomial` followed by `namespace IsHomogeneous`, including the analogous `IsHomogeneous.eval₂` at line 265.
findings.fix: Move it to the root `MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous` namespace and use a receiver-style name such as `eval₂_fun_mul`.
findings.issue: `eval₂_fun_mul_of_isHomogeneous` takes an `MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous` proof first but is in `TauCeti`; Mathlib places operations on such proofs in `MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous`.

summary: The three new theorems are placed in `TauCeti` even though their first explicit arguments support standard dot-notation namespaces.
